{{Top|leg|title=''Farumme''-class hauler}}
The '''''Farumme''-class hauler''' was an [[Adumari]] air vehicle mainly used for hauling cargo and equipment.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

During the brief [[Adumari Civil War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], they served as troop transports for the coalition of nations against [[Cartann]].<ref name="soa" />

Their name was based on the [[farumme]], a labor animal native to Adumar.<ref name="soa" />
